listing_name: North Park Craftsmen House * Great for Families
description:
This Beautiful Craftsman house has all the modern conveniences you and your whole family will enjoy, with the Craftsman feel, in the heart of San Diego.

Walking distance to all the local restaurants, bars, and breweries in the booming neighborhood of North Park.

The home is also great for families!

P.S. This home is the FIRST EVER full property listed on AIRBNB. Read the full story when you come to stay.

If you have any questions, just reach out to me!

The space
The house is located in the heart of North Park. It is the perfect location to be close to all the best attractions in San Diego as well as walking distance to North Park's incredible nightlife with hot new bars and restaurants. The house is also only a couple minutes' drive from Balboa Park, the Zoo, and the gaslamp district Downtown where Comic Con is held. During the day you can head to the beach or Sea World which are a short 10 min drive away. It is the perfect combination of daytime activities in San Diego and nighttime activities within walking distance. At night enjoy the craft beer and cocktails at Belching Beaver tasting room, North Park Brewery, Hess, JuneShine, and so so many more. As well as delicious restaurants. No shortage of nightlife within walking distance of the house.

If you prefer to stay in, enjoy our beautiful backyard area includes comfy seating, a coffee table and kids chairs as well as an outdoor heater in case it is a little chilly. The living room is comfortable and equipped with a swivel-mounted TV connected to Apple TV for all your entertainment needs.

The house is a cute newly remodeled craftsman with hardwood floors and all the modern technology you could ask for and more. High-speed Internet is included. The house is also a smart home so feel free to tell the speaker to lock the front door, change the thermostat, or turn on or off lights.

The master bedroom has a California King size bed. The master has a private bathroom and french doors that lead to the back patio.

The second bedroom has a full size bunk bed with a twin on top and a twin trundle that can pull out below for a max of 4 guests. Great for young ones or parents that want to stay in the room with their little ones as well.

The third bedroom has a brand new queen bed built into the Murphy Bed cabinet. Want extra room during the day or a private office? Just lift the bed back into the wall and you have a desk ready to go. If you have not tried the Purple mattress, we love it and hope you will as well. This room is very cozy and comfortable!

The house is conveniently located within a block of a grocery store, a bus stop and right in the center of the two best areas of North Park (University Ave and Adams Ave.

I have been hosting guests in this home since 2008 in different ways so you will here some past guest comments about dogs or meeting us. We used to just rent out a room in this house. Our dogs passed away several years ago and we now rent out the whole house and we have not had dogs on the premises for many years. If you have allergies, no worries the house has long been swept of any pet allergens.

Come and enjoy your stay in San Diego. We have been hosting Airbnb since it started in 2008 and we love it. We will do everything we can to make sure you enjoy your stay.

Guest access
Guests will have access to everything in the house except the garage and backyard shed.

Other things to note
We have a Tesla charger on-premise and you are welcome to use! The driveway has room for two cars to park in tandem. Street parking is free, but some of the streets have a 2-hour limit so just be careful and check street signs. Do NOT park in the Vons parking lot, they will tow you right away.

description:
Your San Diego hideaway awaits!

Private room w/private entrance in Pacific Beach townhome with shared walls.

This bright and airy space boasts a patio, Wi-Fi, and private bathroom, creating a comfortable and secure haven for your San Diego adventure. Perfect for the traveling professional, the room features a cozy sleeping area and a well-equipped kitchenette with a mini-fridge. Close to parks, shops, restaurants & bars.

1/1/25-There is temporary intermittent construction in the area.

The space
Quiet room in quiet part of lively Pacific Beach. This is my residence and the guest room is downstairs at street level. It's nice and quiet and private.

A short walk (1.5 miles) to the ocean, restaurants, shops and nightlife. 2 miles to SeaWorld or the Mission Beach Roller coaster. A 6 block walk to public transportation.

listing_name: Quiet studio: King bed, AC, Washer
description:
Very centrally located in a quiet, upscale urban neighborhood. California king size mattress, air conditioning, and a washer/dryer for weary travelers are key features our guests love. It's really tiny, but guests visiting San Diego don't spend much time inside!

The space
Hello Travelers!

Welcome to our very small studio, a completely private apartment located minutes from everything in San Diego, in the exclusive South Mission Hills neighborhood.

This apartment is definitely small, but it has everything you could need with kitchenette, bathroom, private patio, and a washer/dryer for your own use. The studio is one end of a private home but is completely separate. And unlike most urban areas of San Diego, there is always plenty of parking on our quiet street.
To be very clear: there is very little counter for cooking; there is only a hotplate (no oven); and the shower is only 30" wide, so it might be a squeeze for some people.

The neighborhood is central, and within walking distance to many shops and bars. It is also freeway close, and within walking distance from the Washington Street Trolley which goes Downtown and to Old Town and beyond. It is a 2-minute drive up to the Zoo, Balboa Park, and Hillcrest, our gay area of town, and one of the liveliest. It is also a mile from UCSD Medical and Scripps Mercy Hospital if you are a physician in training.

The area is alternately called, "Midtown" because it is only 2.2 miles to downtown, and a 1/2 mile from Little Italy. It's also close to the airport, but because we are tucked in a tranquil canyon, the airport noise is minor.

AMENITIES:
- King-size bed w/goose-down comforter
- 32" TV with multiple channels (cable + HBO + Netflix, Amazon movies.)
- Wifi
- Mini Kitchenette: Coffee maker, Toaster, Hot plate, & Mini fridge
- Private Patio
- Washer/Dryer
- Internal heater and Air Conditioning
- Lots of wine glasses, plates, cups, cooking utensils, pots, pans.
- Mini travel hair-dryer (not super powerful, but handy in case you forget yours.)
- Iron, and ironing board
- I also provide coffee/tea, creamer, sweeteners, olive oil, canola oil, salt, pepper, spices etc. (If you are there for an extended stay and run out of coffee say, then you are on your own for additional provisions.)
- 2 big BEACH towels and 2 beach chairs, snorkeling goggles and fins.
- Plentiful PARKING on my quiet street.

RESTAURANTS AND BARS
You are within a couple of blocks of some top bars and restaurants, "International Restaurant Row"
- Gelato Vero Cafe - on the corner, 5 mins by foot for coffee, scones, muffins etc. And yummy desserts.
- Starlite Lounge - San Diego's trendiest supper club for hipsters
- The Regal Beagle - a craft beer drinker's heaven, & artisanal sausages. I recommend the Moroccan Lamb!
- The Wine Vault - Five-course prix fixe dinners paired with Californian wines for $65.
- Shakespeare's Pub - British food, beer and soccer 24/7.
- Blue Water Grill - fresh seafood and great fish tacos.
- Karina's - great octopus tacos, and excellent poke & ceviche.

SHOPPING AND ATTRACTIONS:
You are 5 minutes by car from Fashion Valley, Mission Valley, Sea World, Downtown, Old Town, and Balboa Park. You are 10 minutes from the beach, and 20 from the Mexican Border and North County (for the best surf!).
-Trolley and Bus Lines to downtown or Hillcrest, Little Italy, or Old Town around the corner. The bus stop is a 4 minute walk, and the trolley station (Washington St) is 7 minutes. There are bus schedules/routes in the apartment to peruse.

There are two potential drawbacks to the studio that may affect some: first, I mentioned it's small. But the vaulted ceilings make it seem larger. Second, when weather's foggy or cloudy, it carries the sounds of the airport. Flights are grounded after 11:30pm, and do not resume until 6:30 a.m. As one guest said, "it's not enough to disturb our conversation or sleep."

My very first guest made biscuits one morning during her stay, which is a testament to how comfortable and easy living in our studio is. I think you will be just as comfortable despite its size. The neighborhood is full of high-end homes, and is great for walks or exercising. Some of the best views in San Diego are right at the top of my hill. I hope you enjoy your time in San Diego!

Guest access
Washer and Dryer for your use only. (We have our own inside my house.)

Plenty of street parking.

Other things to note
San Diego is really spread out, so I always recommend a car. You can get to almost every place without going on the freeway, it just takes longer. If you are not comfortable driving, a public transit pass is $5.00 per day, and allows you to travel on any bus or trolley all over the County.
We also now have bike share and scooter share all over the City, so plan on using those sometimes also. Our rules do not require a helmet for using a scooter, but you may only drive it on the street, not the sidewalk.

description:
This charming vacation apartment is a five minute walk to the beach and within 10-20 minute drive of nearly everything San Diego has to offer including Sea World, San Diego Zoo, Balboa Park, Old Town, Gaslamp District and so much more!

NOTE: 1 pet per rental please

The space
Before we start telling you about about how great our property is, we want you to know about two negative things right up front so you won't waste your time if they are deal-killers for you. The first being, that we are near the airport flight path and there will be considerable plane noise throughout the day. By law, the planes must stop running after 10pm, but there have been rare occasions that a plane will fly over anyway and pay the fine. Most people who stay here say they get used to it fairly quickly but if you are sensitive to noise or just looking for a quiet space, alas, this is not for you.

Secondly, we do not have off-street parking available. There is free street parking but understand that being a block from the beach can sometimes make it difficult. In the daytime, it's usually easy to find parking right out front, but as it gets later toward the evening, when people start coming home from work, it becomes more difficult. You'll always find a space, but you might need to widen your search perimeter. The good news is that there is soooo much in walking distance (restaurants, bars, dog beach, ocean beach, markets, shops, The Farmer's Market etc.) and a ton of attractions that are a cheap Uber ride away (Sea World, SD Zoo, Gaslamp, Belmont Park, Mission Beach and other beaches to name a few.)

Now for the good stuff . . . Our cozy apartment is one and a half blocks from the beach. There is a small front yard, a furnished deck with a barbecue grill, patio table, chairs and umbrella. Inside is tile flooring and relatively new furniture and decorations.

PLEASE NOTE: One of the residents of the property has a very friendly dog named Frankie. She is not aggressive, or in any way mean, but can be a bit yappy when a new guest arrives. We just want you to be aware in case anyone in your group has an issue with dogs but rest assured, she is a sweetheart and just excited to meet new people.

Ocean Beach is an authentic, ocean-front community with an eclectic, intimate character that is revered by travelers from around the world. It is a perfect destination for families, couples, singles, surfers, boaters, explorers - people with active lifestyles or people who just want to relax on the beach. Everything San Diego has to offer is virtually at your doorstep. Or, spend the day at home. Read the morning paper on the deck with a cup of coffee, barbecue steaks at dinner time on the patio, or just lounge with a cold beer by the firepit after an invigorating day at the beach.

Amenities include indoor and outdoor furniture, fully-equipped kitchen, TV/DVD, stereo, stable WiFi and internet, bath towels, linens, pillows, blankets - all the comforts of home.

An air mattress is available if you want to bring the kids but must be requested in advance.


IMPORTANT THINGS TO CONSIDER BEFORE BOOKING

Pets are not allowed to relieve themselves on the property. You will need to walk the animal off-property and clean up afterward. Failure to do so could result in a loss of some or all of your pet deposit.

We are a small, family-owned operation. Like you, we love to travel and we know what it means to provide quality customer service. For the duration of your stay, we will be available all hours for all your needs. Just check our reviews, not a bad one in the bunch!

ATTRACTIONS WITHIN WALKING DISTANCE

1) PACIFIC OCEAN – Forget the car! Just walk to the beach in 5 minutes.

2) SAN DIEGO RIVER TRAIL - Beginning at the Ocean, and only a block or so from the bungalow, The San Diego River trail is excellent for wildlife viewing; bird watchers from all over the county come to snap pictures, and get good sightings and light for an array of wildlife. Fish are always jumping, eagles and hawks are often flying with live catches in their talons or beaks, and the varying tides ensure the visit is never the same twice.

3) ROBB FIELD – is a huge park and recreation complex with multiple tennis, basketball and handball court. It also has a fitness gym, lighted softball and multi-purpose fields, playground area for kids, and acres of wide open grass with picnic tables and shade trees.

4) CRAFT BEER BREWERIES AND TASTING ROOMS - San Diego is known to be the craft brewery capital of the country with more craft breweries per capita than any other city. Here in OB we have several breweries and tasting rooms of some of the more acclaimed craft brands such as Pizza Port, Belching Beaver, Mike Hess Brewery, Culture Brewing, Helms Brewing and the Ocean Beach Brewing Company all within a 10-minute walk from your front door.

5) ROBB SKATEBOARD PARK – is a recently-built, 40 thousand square foot, state-of-the-art skate park.

6) MAIN STREET OCEAN BEACH (NEWPORT AVENUE) – Stroll along Antique Row or shop in any of the dozens of mom-n-pop retail stores. Roam the Farmers Market and Street Fair every Wednesday afternoon. Afterward have lunch, or an adult beverage, at one of the many restaurants, nightclubs and neighborhood bars.

7) OCEAN BEACH PIER – is the second longest pier in California. It’s an amazing, panoramic location from which to drop a fishing line (no license needed), take a romantic stroll, or grab a burger and a beer at the OB Pier Café.

8) THE TIDE POOLS OF SUNSET CLIFFS – Stroll along the stunning, striated Sunset Cliffs of the Pacific Ocean. This is one of the most beautiful locations in the world, named after its amazing sunsets. Take a leisurely stroll down to sea level and explore the magic and the mystery of the tide pools at low tide.

9) BIRD WATCHING AT THE FAMOSA SLOUGH – Birdwatchers come from around the world to see the many different, exotic birds that inhabit this 37-acre wetland, including, Osprey, Snowy Egrets, pelicans, ducks, sandpipers in the estuary Black-necked Stilts, Avocets, Kingfisher, Forster's Tern, and Great Egret. Walk or bike on the path that circumnavigates the slough.

ATTRACTIONS WITHIN DRIVING DISTANCE

10 MINUTES – is all the driving time you need to visit Sea World, Seaport Village, Historic Old Town, Downtown San Diego and the historic Gaslamp Quarter, San Diego Convention Center, Little Italy, Maritime Museums, Petco Park (Padres stadium), and San Diego’s main airport, Lindbergh field.

20 MINUTES – to San Diego Zoo, Balboa Park and Museums, Torrey Pines Golf Course, five outdoor shopping malls, Qualcomm stadium (Chargers), Coronado Island and the historic Hotel Del Coronado, Cabrillo National Monument and Lighthouse.

30 MINUTES - to Tijuana and the Mexico border, Del Mar Racetrack and Fairgrounds, Several Indian gaming casinos, Legoland, etc.

As you can see, there is so much to see and do within a close distance of our vacation units you probably won't be able to do it all in once visit. Which is why we want you to come back.

Best!

description:
On the tip of Mission Beach, our home is surrounded by water in three directions. This is a three-bedroom lower level duplex with water views, private carport and garage, and BBQ

The space
Thank you for your interest in our place! Please send us a quick message to confirm availability before you book. We will respond quickly.

Feel free to visit our website for additional details: staceys vacation home (all one word) dott com

Please note that we have a 7 night minimum June 16 through August 18, Saturday - Saturday reservations only. We also require one week reservations for Thanksgiving and the holidays. For the rest of the year, we have a 4 night minimum for weekends (2 night minimum stay is fine midweek).

Renovated in February 2015, this beach duplex has two brand new kitchens, bathrooms, and beautiful tiled flooring. It is not your typical rental with bare walls and stiff sheets; it welcomes its visitors with all the luxuries and amenities of vacationing within their own home. The duplex includes a larger unit with two bedrooms and and one full bathroom, and a smaller unit with one bedroom and one bathroom. There are two flat screen smart televisions with Netflix subscriptions. There is sleeping for 10 people comfortably in the bedrooms plus convertible sofas in the living rooms.

The beds are:

Large Unit Master - One Queen
Large Unit Second - bunk bed (two Queens)
Large Unit Living Room - Full Size Convertible Sofa
Small Unit Master - One Queen
Small Unit Living Room - Full Size Convertible Sofa

South Mission Bay offers a beautiful un-crowded white sand beach ideal for families with young children. Our home is steps to Mission Point Park, which features a playground for the kids, picnic tables, and grassy areas for bocce ball, horseshoes, or walking your dog.

On the ocean side, South Mission Beach offers aspiring surfers and boogie boarders with a good beach break under the watchful eyes of the lifeguards at the South Mission Beach Lifeguard station. This is also the location of world famous volleyball courts where many tournaments are held. Beach-side and Bay-side walk ways offer miles of jogging, biking, walking, or skating pleasure.

Parking at the beach is a rarity and this home comes with one covered parking spot in the carport directly next to the small unit front door. The spot is large enough for even large trucks and SUVs. There is also an attached one car garage.

There are two BBQs and outdoor seating. We provide propane for our guests.

Plus, the outdoor shower lets you leave the sand outdoors and easily wash all beach toys.

The stunning location allows for the enjoyment of Sea World's fire works in the summer as well as the ease and access to all of San Diego’s other beautiful sights and events. Welcome home!

About the owner: Andrew and I love the beach and all it has to offer. The sunsets are amazing and the sea life is ever changing. In a busy world we take the time to slow down and soak in Mission Beach. From sunrise walks along the beach to paddle boarding within the tranquil Mission Bay, we would be delighted to share this bit of paradise with you!

Why the Owner Chose Mission Beach:
We adore this location with the perfect mixture of liveliness of nearby Pacific Beach and the quiet escape of the beautiful Mission Bay. Everything is within reach but the sanctity of an escape awaits just behind our doors.

This is a quiet neighborhood and is the perfect getaway for a relaxing vacation with the fun and excitement within reach. Quiet hours are after 10pm in which all must be off the patios with doors and windows closed if the fun is brought inside. Our neighborhood echoes and we respect all of our neighboring tenants. Parties or events of any kind are not allowed. Smoking on the property is prohibited. We have a strict no pet policy.

FAQ

How does check-in work? Is a key exchange necessary?
The front door is coded, a key exchange is not necessary. You can check-in anytime after 3pm.

Do you allow early check-in or late check-out?
We usually will have another group coming or going so we are not able to accommodate an early check-in or a late check-out. You are welcome to swing by early and drop off your bags, but you will not be able to get settled in until the cleaning crew is finished at 3pm. We will usually have an area you can leave bags for a while after checking out as well. Pease contact us for more details

Is smoking allowed on the property?
Smoking is strictly prohibited anywhere on the property, including patios, carports, garages, and garden areas. If smoking occurs on the property, the security deposit will be forfeited. Smoking is also not allowed on the boardwalks or beaches and ticketing is a common occurrence.

Are pets or service animals allowed?
Unfortunately due to our liability insurance coverage and guests’ allergies, we must prohibit any animals on the property. If a guest arrives with an animal or brings an animal to the property anytime during their stay they will be evicted and the security deposit will be forfeited. We will then attempt to re-rent the unit and the guest will have the portion of rent returned that was filled by the new reservation. If we are unable to re-rent the property, no rent will be returned.

Are events or parties allowed?
No, we do not allow events or parties of any kind. If a party or event is held on the property, the security deposit will be forfeited and the guests will be evicted.

Do you have a coffee maker?
We do provide coffee makers. We do not stock coffee filters, however previous guests may leave behind their filters, which you are welcome to use.

Do you have a hair dryer?
Yes each unit has one small hair dryer.

What kitchen supplies are provided?
We provide basic cooking supplies, dishware, and utensils. We provide salt and pepper, but we do not provide any other ingredients or perishables. We have a basic coffee maker, blender, and toaster. Guests might leave behind some items like seasonings or cooking oil, but we do not stock these items.

Are plenty of towels and linens provided?
Yes, we provide all of the towels, sheets, comforters, and beach towels you will need.

What bathroom supplies are provided?
We provide toilet paper, hand soap, shampoo, conditioner, and body wash.

Do you provide a Pack ‘n Play or any other toddler supplies?
Yes, we have a Pack ‘n Play you can use, but we do not have a stroller or high chair.

Are there a washer and dryer at the house?
Yes, you have access to a free washer and dryer on the property. Laundry detergent is also provided.

Do you have air conditioning?
We do not have air conditioning; very few homes in the area have air conditioning due to the coastal breeze that keeps the area pretty comfortable year round. Each room has either a ceiling fan or a stand up fan to help with air circulation during the occasional heat wave.

What beach supplies are provided?
We provide boogie boards, sand toys, beach chairs, and beach towels. Some guests might leave behind other supplies like beach umbrellas and sports equipment, but we do not stock these items.

Do you have dependable Wi-Fi?
Yes, we have Wi-Fi throughout the house.

Is the property private? Are there any shared spaces with the other units?
The house is a triplex, and each unit has its own private entry, patio area, BBQ, parking, and beach supplies. The laundry area is a shared area.

We ran out of something (toilet paper, paper towels, trash bags, soap, detergent, propane, etc), should we call you or go buy more?
Please call us. We stock extra supplies and we are happy to direct you to our backstock if needed.

Where can we park extra cars?
Street parking can become tricky in the summer so always read the signs posted as street sweeping takes place almost every weekday (except Wednesdays) and some areas are limited to 15 minutes, 30 minutes, or 2 hours. Ticketing cars is a frequent occurrence here at the beach so be aware.

How close is the beach?
Mission Beach is a skinny peninsula; both the Bayside and Oceanside have sandy beaches and a lively boardwalk. We are one property away from the bayfront and about 100 yards away from the oceanfront. The bay is calmer with warmer water. The ocean is livelier and has great waves.

Do you provide beach cruisers?
We do not, but there are several bike rental places within walking distance.

Where is the closest grocery and drug store?
The closest large grocery store is Ralphs, located at: 4315 Mission Blvd, San Diego, CA 92109
The closest drug store is CVS located at: 1792 Garnet Ave, San Diego, CA 92109

Is the noise policy strict?
Yes, we require guests to respect our neighborhood and we enforce appropriate noise levels throughout the day and strict quiet hours after 10pm. If you are bothered by any noise violations while staying with us, do not hesitate to call; we can help by contacting other guests or owners of other properties to notify them that a nuisance is being caused. If a neighbor reports a noise disturbance or police are called and a violation is issued, the guest security deposit will be forfeited.

Is the property wheelchair accessible?
Only the ground floor is wheelchair accessible. We do not have wheelchair accessible showers.

Is the house and neighborhood family friendly?
Yes, we are in a very family friendly area. Our house is one property away from the bayfront in a quiet and safe neighborhood.

Do you have a BBQ?
Yes, each unit has it’s own BBQ and we provide propane. If you run out of propane please call us.

Where are the linens for the convertible sleeper sofa?
The linens are stored inside the chaise section of the sofa.


Please feel free to contact us anytime!

The bay, the ocean, and the jetty provide the best views in San Diego. This is our three-bedroom two-bathroom second floor unit with third floor rooftop patio within a duplex featuring high ceilings, beautifully tiled flooring, and a spacious layout. This home is not your typical rental with bare walls and stiff sheets; it welcomes its visitors with all the luxuries and amenities of vacationing within their own home. The custom built details and personalized decorations create the feeling of luxury and comfort. The handcrafted kitchen contains top of the line appliances and beautiful granite counter tops and its open layout allows for easy entertainment for family and friends. Living Room - Full Size Convertible Sofa

Three beautiful patios areas have plenty of lounging areas to enjoy the beach air and sun. The top two decks of this beautiful home overlook Mission Bay to the east, the Jetty to the South, and Ocean Beach to the West. The garden patio on the ground floor has a grill and two picnic areas. Plus, the outdoor shower lets you leave the sand outdoors and easily wash all beach toys.

The stunning location allows for the enjoyment of Sea World's fire works in the summer as well as the ease and access to all of San Diego’s other beautiful sights and events. Welcome home!

About the owner: Andrew and I love the beach and all it has to offer. The sunsets are amazing and the sea life is ever changing. In a busy world we take the time to slow down and soak in Mission Beach. From sunrise walks along the beach to paddle boarding within the tranquil Mission Bay, we would be delighted to share this bit of paradise with you!

Why the Owner Chose Mission Beach:
We adore this location with the perfect mixture of liveliness of nearby Pacific Beach and the quiet escape of the beautiful Mission Bay. Everything is within reach but the sanctity of an escape awaits just behind our doors.

The Unique Benefits at this House:
The secluded rooftop deck overlooks the beautiful Mission Bay and has the perfect view of Ocean Beach's 'Dog Beach' across the jetty.

This is a quiet neighborhood and is the perfect getaway for a relaxing vacation with the fun and excitement within reach. Quiet hours are after 10pm in which all must be off the rooftop and doors and windows closed if the fun is brought inside. Our neighborhood echoes and we respect all of our neighboring tenants. Parties and events of any kind are not allowed. Smoking anywhere on the property is prohibited. We have a strict no pet policy.

FAQ

How does check-in work? Is a key exchange necessary?
The front door is coded, a key exchange is not necessary. You can check-in anytime after 3pm.

Do you allow early check-in or late check-out?
We usually will have another group coming or going so we are not able to accommodate an early check-in or a late check-out. You are welcome to swing by early and drop off your bags, but you will not be able to get settled in until the cleaning crew is finished at 3pm. We will usually have an area you can leave bags for a while after checking out as well. Pease contact us for more details

Is smoking allowed on the property?
Smoking is strictly prohibited anywhere on the property, including patios, carports, garages, and garden areas. If smoking occurs on the property, the security deposit will be forfeited. Smoking is also not allowed on the boardwalks or beaches and ticketing is a common occurrence.

Are pets or service animals allowed?
Unfortunately due to our liability insurance coverage and guests’ allergies, we must prohibit any animals on the property. If a guest arrives with an animal or brings an animal to the property anytime during their stay they will be evicted and the security deposit will be forfeited. We will then attempt to re-rent the unit and the guest will have the portion of rent returned that was filled by the new reservation. If we are unable to re-rent the property, no rent will be returned.

Are events or parties allowed?
No, we do not allow events or parties of any kind. If a party or event is held on the property, the security deposit will be forfeited and the guests will be evicted.

Do you have a coffee maker?
We do provide coffee makers. We do not stock coffee filters, however previous guests may leave behind their filters, which you are welcome to use.

Do you have a hair dryer?
Yes each unit has one small hair dryer.

What kitchen supplies are provided?
We provide basic cooking supplies, dishware, and utensils. We provide salt and pepper, but we do not provide any other ingredients or perishables. We have a basic coffee maker, blender, and toaster. Guests might leave behind some items like seasonings or cooking oil, but we do not stock these items.

Are plenty of towels and linens provided?
Yes, we provide all of the towels, sheets, comforters, and beach towels you will need.

What bathroom supplies are provided?
We provide toilet paper, hand soap, shampoo, conditioner, and body wash.

Do you provide a Pack ‘n Play or any other toddler supplies?
Yes, we have a Pack ‘n Play you can use, but we do not have a stroller or high chair.

Are there a washer and dryer at the house?
Yes, you have access to a free washer and dryer on the property. Laundry detergent is also provided.

Do you have air conditioning?
We do not have air conditioning; very few homes in the area have air conditioning due to the coastal breeze that keeps the area pretty comfortable year round. Each room has either a ceiling fan or a stand up fan to help with air circulation during the occasional heat wave. We have space heaters as well.

What beach supplies are provided?
We provide boogie boards, sand toys, beach chairs, and beach towels. Some guests might leave behind other supplies like beach umbrellas and sports equipment, but we do not stock these items.

Do you have dependable Wi-Fi?
Yes, we have Wi-Fi throughout the house.

Is the property private? Are there any shared spaces with the other units?
The house is a triplex, and each unit has its own private entry, patio area, BBQ, parking, and beach supplies. The laundry area is a shared area.

We ran out of something (toilet paper, paper towels, trash bags, soap, detergent, propane, etc), should we call you or go buy more?
Please call us. We stock extra supplies and we are happy to direct you to our backstock if needed.

Where can we park extra cars?
Street parking can become tricky in the summer so always read the signs posted as street sweeping takes place almost every weekday (except Wednesdays) and some areas are limited to 15 minutes, 30 minutes, or 2 hours. Ticketing cars is a frequent occurrence here at the beach so be aware.

How close is the beach?
Mission Beach is a skinny peninsula; both the Bayside and Oceanside have sandy beaches and a lively boardwalk. We are one property away from the bayfront and about 100 yards away from the oceanfront. The bay is calmer with warmer water. The ocean is livelier and has great waves.

Do you provide beach cruisers?
We do not, but there are several bike rental places within walking distance.

Where is the closest grocery and drug store?
The closest large grocery store is Ralphs, located at: 4315 Mission Blvd, San Diego, CA 92109
The closest drug store is CVS located at: 1792 Garnet Ave, San Diego, CA 92109

Is the noise policy strict?
Yes, we require guests to respect our neighborhood and we enforce appropriate noise levels throughout the day and strict quiet hours after 10pm. If you are bothered by any noise violations while staying with us, do not hesitate to call; we can help by contacting other guests or owners of other properties to notify them that a nuisance is being caused. If a neighbor reports a noise disturbance or police are called and a violation is issued, the guest security deposit will be forfeited.

Is the property wheelchair accessible?
Only the ground floor is wheelchair accessible. We do not have wheelchair accessible showers.

Is the house and neighborhood family friendly?
Yes, we are in a very family friendly area. Our house is one property away from the bayfront in a quiet and safe neighborhood.

Do you have a BBQ?
Yes, each unit has it’s own BBQ and we provide propane. If you run out of propane please call us.

Where are the linens for the convertible sleeper sofa?
The linens are stored inside the chaise section of the sofa.

Please feel free to contact us anytime!

The cottage features a private entrance to your own patio, complete with picnic table and lounging area. If you want to add more guests, inquire about our cottage next door that sleeps 4. We can open gate to connect the yards giving you lots more outdoor space!

Dine indoors at the counter bar, the table, or dine al fresco under the stars at the picnic table.

The North Park cottage is a tiny home and completely private. You have your own entrance and private patio area to enjoy!

There is no smoking in the cottage or on the premises. Please respect our home, and this will allow us to keep it open to travelers wanting a better option than a hotel.

description:
This charming vacation apartment is a five minute walk to the beach and within 10-20 minute drive of nearly everything San Diego has to offer including Sea World, San Diego Zoo, Balboa Park, Old Town, Gaslamp District and so much more!

NOTE: 1 pet per rental please

The space
Before bragging about about how great our property is, we want you to know about two negative things right up front so you won't waste your time if they are deal-killers for you. The first being, that we are near the airport flight path and there will be considerable plane noise throughout the day. By law, the planes must stop running after 10pm, but there have been rare occasions that a plane will fly over anyway and pay the fine. Most people who stay here say they get used to it fairly quickly but if you are sensitive to noise or just looking for a quiet space, alas, this is not for you.

Secondly, we do not have off-street parking available. There is free street parking but understand that being a block from the beach can sometimes make it difficult. In the daytime, it's usually easy to find parking right out front, but as it gets later toward the evening, when people start coming home from work, it becomes more difficult. You'll always find a space, but you might need to widen your search perimeter. The good news is that there is soooo much in walking distance (restaurants, bars, dog beach, ocean beach, markets, shops, The Farmer's Market etc.) and a ton of attractions that are a cheap Uber ride away (Sea World, SD Zoo, Gaslamp, Belmont Park, Mission Beach and other beaches to name a few.)

Now for the good stuff . . . Our cozy apartment is one and a half blocks from the beach. There is a small front yard, a completely furnished deck with a barbecue grill, patio table, chairs and umbrella. Inside is tile and hardwood flooring.

PLEASE NOTE: One of the residents of the property has a very friendly dog named Frankie. She is not aggressive, or in any way mean to humans or other dogs, but can be a bit yappy when a new guest arrives. We just want you to be aware in case anyone in your group has an issue with dogs but rest assured, she is a sweetheart and just excited to meet new people.

Unfortunately, we only allow 1 pet per unit, but other than that we are a:

Pet / Dog Friendly Neighborhood
Pet / Dog Friendly Yard
Pet / Dog Friendly Owner
Pet / Dog Friendly beach nearby
No pet charges or pet fees
Free Pet vacation rental


IMPORTANT THINGS TO CONSIDER BEFORE BOOKING

This property is near the airport flight path and can be loud at periodic moments when planes fly over head. This is true for much of Ocean Beach

Pets are not allowed to relieve themselves on the property. You will need to walk the animal off-property and clean up afterward. Failure to do so could result in a loss of some or all of your pet deposit.

Ocean Beach is an authentic, ocean-front community with an eclectic, intimate character that is revered by travelers from around the world. It is a perfect destination for families, couples, singles, surfers, boaters, explorers - people with active lifestyles or people who just want to relax on the beach. Everything San Diego has to offer is virtually at your doorstep. Or, spend the day at home. Read the morning paper on the deck with a cup of coffee, barbecue steaks at dinner time on the patio, or just lounge with a cold beer by the firepit after an invigorating day at the beach.

Amenities include indoor and outdoor furniture, fully-equipped kitchen, TV/DVD, stereo, DVD library, WiFi internet, bath towels, beach towels, hair dryer, linens, pillows, blankets - all the comforts of home.

We are a small, family-owned operation. Like you, we love to travel and we know what it means to provide quality customer service. For the duration of your stay, we will be available all hours for all your needs. Just check the reviews, not a bad one in the bunch!


ATTRACTIONS WITHIN WALKING DISTANCE

1) PACIFIC OCEAN – Forget the car! Just walk to the beach in 5 minutes.

2) SAN DIEGO RIVER TRAIL - Beginning at the Ocean, and only a block or so from the bungalow, The San Diego River trail is excellent for wildlife viewing; bird watchers from all over the county come to snap pictures, and get good sightings and light for an array of wildlife. Fish are always jumping, eagles and hawks are often flying with live catches in their talons or beaks, and the tides make sure the visit is never the same twice.

3) ROBB FIELD – is a huge park and recreation complex with multiple tennis, basketball and handball court. It also has a fitness gym, lighted softball and multi-purpose fields, playground area for kids, and acres of wide open grass with picnic tables and shade trees.

4) 4) CRAFT BEER BREWERIES AND TASTING ROOMS - San Diego is known to be the craft brewery capital of the country with more craft breweries per capita than any other city. Here in OB we have several breweries and tasting rooms of some of the more acclaimed craft brands such as Pizza Port, Belching Beaver, Mike Hess Brewery, Culture Brewing, Helms Brewing and the Ocean Beach Brewing Company all within a 10-minute walk from your front door.

5) ROBB SKATEBOARD PARK – is a recently-built, 40 thousand square foot, state-of-the-art skate park.

6) MAIN STREET OCEAN BEACH (NEWPORT AVENUE) – Stroll along Antique Row or shop in any of the dozens of mom-n-pop retail stores. Roam the Farmers Market and Street Fair every Wednesday afternoon. Afterward have lunch, or an adult beverage, at one of the many restaurants, nightclubs and neighborhood bars.

7) OCEAN BEACH PIER – is the second longest pier in California. It’s an amazing, panoramic location from which to drop a fishing line (no license needed), take a romantic stroll, or grab a burger and a beer at the OB Pier Café.

8) THE TIDE POOLS OF SUNSET CLIFFS – Stroll along the stunning, striated Sunset Cliffs of the Pacific Ocean. This is one of the most beautiful locations in the world, named after its amazing sunsets. Take a leisurely stroll down to sea level and explore the magic and the mystery of the tide pools at low tide.

9) BIRD WATCHING AT THE FAMOSA SLOUGH – Birdwatchers come from around the world to see the many different, exotic birds that inhabit this 37-acre wetland, including, Osprey, Snowy Egrets, pelicans, ducks, sandpipers in the estuary Black-necked Stilts, Avocets, Kingfisher, Forster's Tern, and Great Egret. Walk or bike on the path that circumnavigates the slough.

ATTRACTIONS WITHIN DRIVING DISTANCE

10 MINUTES – is all the driving time you need to visit Sea World, Seaport Village, Historic Old Town, Downtown San Diego and the historic Gaslamp Quarter, San Diego Convention Center, Little Italy, Maritime Museums, Petco Park (Padres stadium), and San Diego’s main airport, Lindbergh field.

20 MINUTES – to San Diego Zoo, Balboa Park and Museums, Torrey Pines Golf Course, five outdoor shopping malls, Qualcomm stadium (Chargers), Coronado Island and the historic Hotel Del Coronado, Cabrillo National Monument and Lighthouse.

30 MINUTES - to Tijuana and the Mexico border, Del Mar Racetrack and Fairgrounds, Several Indian gaming casinos, Legoland, etc.


As you can see, there is so much to see and do within a close distance of our vacation units you probably won't be able to do it all in once visit. Which is why we want you to come back.

Best!

Ed Decker

listing_name: Enjoy Stunning Views of San Diego!
description:
You can enjoy "Valemont Vista," our 3 bedroom, 2 bath family home on centrally located but quiet & safe Point Loma. Enjoy meals on our balcony patio while viewing the incredible views of Shelter Island, San Diego harbor and downtown day or night.

The space
The amazing views can be seen from the living room, dining room, kitchen and back bedroom. You will find cable tv in the living room and wireless internet access throughout the house. Within the last ten years, new flooring was installed replacing carpeting as well as new energy efficient appliances (washer, dryer, dishwasher). To save even more energy, we encourage the use of the clothes drying rack next to the dryer.

To make your stay at our Valemont Vista even more interesting and relaxing, some of you might consider taking a break and unplugging from the digital world stepping back into an earlier time before smart phones, computers and the flat screen tv. You will find the latter in the living room. Our home was built in 1958 with high standards and equipped to be "all electric" and very modern for its time. Though most of the appliances have been upgraded as mentioned, you can still enjoy the charming retro style kitchen counters, electric stove and oven, breakfast nook, wooden kitchen and pantry cabinets and colorfully tiled bathrooms that many have come to appreciate. Others who prefer only newer homes and furnishings should probably look elsewhere.

The electric ceiling heat, however, is one fifties feature we replaced with new thermostats and more efficient electric wall heaters provided in each room along with smoke detectors. There are enough beds to sleep six.

In summary, visitors find our unique home comfortable and interesting with its continuously changing amazing views and charming retro style. As seen below, it's also ideally located for exploring southern California and Mexico.

Guest access
In addition to the balcony patio with the view, we have a fenced backyard with an additional patio and lemon and orange trees. Help yourself to a lemon to use with your meal or drink. There is a closet in the master bedroom and the garage with tool room behind it in that are not for use by renters. You also have access to another small storage closet in the master bedroom, to books by the front door and to maps and tourist attraction information in the breakfast nook area of the kitchen. The latter is fully equipped with pots, pans, dishes and utensils as well as some basic items for your use such as tea, coffee, and spices. For the dishwasher, we ask that you use the soap tablets and rinsing liquid provided. For the washer, we provide the hd type laundry soap recommended for that appliance as well directions for it and the dryer's use. For more energy saving and the environment, we encourage you to hang clothes on the clothes rack weather and time permitting. For the same reason, we ask that you separate your recyclables into the marked bins including compostible items (except for meat, fish or dairy) which go into the small silver container in the kitchen. If it fills or your stay is over, please empty it in the “greens “ bin that is also green whereas recycling goes in the blue bin.. We appreciate your help and cooperation.

Other things to note
A wonderful way to experience San Diego is to hike, drive or bike from the house 3.5 miles out on Point Loma with breathtaking views of San Diego bay on one side and the Pacific Ocean on the other until you reach the Cabrillo National Monument with its lighthouse, tide pools, nature trails and visitor and whale watching centers. It's not to be missed whether you drive out in 10 minutes or spend the day exploring on foot or bike. Note, however, there is a National Monument use fee of at least $10 for those walking or biking and more for those driving.

Attractions with no cost are over the hill about a mile to the west at the beautiful Sunset Cliffs park where you can join others for the satisfying daily ritual of watching the sun sink into the Pacific. Nearby Ocean Beach is one of our favorites, a quirky, diverse community with a fine beach for sunbathing, boogie boards and surfing. Its colorful shops, restaurants, a special area of beach for dogs (off leash ok). The long OB pier is currently closed for major repair but allows fishing and close-up views of surfers. OB has something for everyone. For example, its old-time Ocean Beach Hardware store is probably the best and most helpful in the San Diego area.

listing_name: Pet-Friendly Blanca Bungalow Artist Retreat
description:
Pet-friendly artist's bungalow in the coolest location. A mix of old & new, the Blanca Bungalow is a cozy 600+ sqft with outdoor spaces to make the most of your San Diego stay. High-quality linens, fully-stocked kitchen, and art supplies to spark your creativity. 1 block from excellent restaurants, pubs, and shops, (even a mini-Target). 5 min drive to downtown, Balboa Park, Golf, and Zoo. South Park is Pup paradise: HUGE local off-leash dog park & many restaurants have dog-friendly patios.

The space
The Blanca Bungalow is a cozy, well-stocked recently updated 1920s California Craftsman centrally located in South Park, an idyllic San Diego neighborhood with historic homes, a relaxed vibe, and excellent dining and shopping.

**Important to note that it has fans, but does not have AC.**

The Blanca Bungalow takes full advantage of the San Diego weather with front and back outdoor living spaces for long conversations or a long afternoon snooze on the shaded back porch under the overhead fan.

It sleeps 4 comfortably, two queens with high-quality linens. The kitchen is fully-stocked with everything you could possibly need during your stay, you just add the groceries, which you can find one block up at the mini-Target. There is also a full-sized washer and dryer, a tankless water heater, and filtered water from the kitchen sink. And for fun we provide board games, puzzles, art supplies, Roku to stream your apps, and high-speed fiber wireless internet.

PETS ARE WELCOME
South Park is DOG FRIENDLY and The Blanca Bungalow honors this by welcoming your well-mannered fuzzy friends – dog bowls, chewy toys and poo bags provided. Most shops and restaurants in South Park allow well-behaved dogs.

Other things to note
South Park is exceptionally walkable so neighbors are always out and about, saying hello and friendly. Neighbors on all sides of the Bungalow are world travelers and welcoming.

Start your day at one of several charming coffee spots - check out Communal Coffee's vintage trailer and vibrant patio, Dark Horse Coffee Roasters' salted maple latte, or Seven Seas Roasting Co. for direct-trade coffee. Don't miss Secret Sister's renowned sourdough everything—breads, donuts, and pastries made from a 150-year-old starter—or Café Madeleine's authentic French pastries and crêpes. If you grab brunch at Matteo don’t leave without a loaf of freshly baked bread!

Between sips and bites, browse The Book Catapult for literary treasures and staff recommendations.​​​​​​​​​ Ask about visiting authors and special events.

For lunch, enjoy the renowned Shawarma Guys (named the top food truck in the country), Italian fare at Buona Forchetta (named best pizza in San Diego) or plant-based dishes at Kindred (named one of the best restaurants in San Diego).

Explore South Park boutiques like Native Poppy for flowers and gifts, browse records at Vinyl Junkie Record Shack, or find vintage treasures at Bad Madge & Co. Take your pup to the five-acre Grape Street Dog Park, stroll through the neighborhood during quarterly Walkabouts, or visit Cobalt Gallery for local art.

End your day with space-themed drinks at Mothership, followed by charcoal-grilled specialties at Carbón or cozy Italian at Il Posto or Piacere Mio. Then slide into Whistle Stop, our neighborhood dive, for live music or DJ-driven dance parties.

listing_name: The Cali Surf Palace
description:
Our home is cozy and warm and very welcoming. We take pride in having and living in a QUIET, peaceful home, it is NOT A WORK SPACE, including online meetings and online work. We also very much encourage our guests to take full advantage of their time in our beautiful city. We aren’t a hotel and we live in our home so we don’t expect our guests to hang out in their room all day. If you love to get out and explore, our place is for you. We look forward to meeting you soon!

The space
A Single room with a Queen size bed and plenty of closet space with a private bath separate from the bedroom in a very cool and relaxed home.
We're located in a quiet and friendly cul de sac, with an open back yard, and a deck overlooking San Clemente Canyon.
Our neighborhood is centrally located with easy freeway access: 10-15 minutes from the San Diego International Airport,Seaworld, the San Diego Zoo, Downtown and all its amazing attractions, restaurants & nightlife; 5 minutes to the beach at La Jolla, 15 minutes to the Race Track at Del Mar! We're a quick drive to several shopping centers, too. The Trolley, and Amtrak/Coaster stations are 12 minutes away, and you're just a stroll away from the bus line. UCSD, Scripps Institute and USD are all within 10 minutes by car. SDSU is about a 20 minute drive from our house as well.
If you're coming for Comic Con, we are 15-20 minutes from the Convention Center, or 10 minutes from the Trolley to park and ride in.
We are close to everything here, so many great places to eat, shop, have fun and relax; even in our back yard! There is even a Starbucks right up the street!!
Price includes city room taxes, refreshments in room and occasional baked goods by Mamasherry to take with you on your way out to explore our beautiful city!

The Cali Surf palace is definitely a welcome home full of Aloha for everyone; and once you've been here you're part of the family!

Guest access
No laundry facilities
Absolutely no cooking

During your stay
We love meeting new people and we love interacting with our guests. We also love sharing the Southern California Experience, with visitors, while respecting the privacy of our guests.

Other things to note
We love to share our knowledge of great places to eat and awesome urban wineries around our great city!
